title: Finite proper coefficient comparison is invertible
statement: For a finite coefficient change and a proper morphism, the proper scalar mate is an isomorphism on every derived coefficient module.

source.note: Lower proper factor isolated from finiteComparison_isIso.

proof.text: Finite freeness identifies the proper restriction square with a finite biproduct comparison. Additive proper direct image preserves it, and the scalar adjunction mate preserves invertibility.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteProperComparison_isIso {R S : Coefficients.{u}} (a : Change R S)
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (g : U ⟶ V)
    (K : DerivedCategory (pbcModules U (R.ring U))) :
    IsIso ((finiteProperComparison a g).app K)
